class.name: Box2DPhysicsServer2D
class.brief_description: Native Box2D physics server with body metadata and move events.
class.description: This backend is provided when the Box2D module is enabled. Obtain the active server or world direct state; do not instantiate this abstract class directly.

method.name: body_get_user_data
method.description: Returns the application metadata assigned with [method body_set_user_data]. An invalid [param body] reports an error and returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: body_portable_identity
method.description: Returns the persistent canonical identity of [param body] assigned by the most recent portable capture of its space, or [code]0[/code] if the body has not been captured. Identities persist across captures: a surviving body keeps its identity, a new body receives a fresh one and a removed body's identity is never reused.

method.name: body_set_user_data
method.description: Associates an arbitrary [Variant] with the valid [param body] RID. This is application metadata returned by [method body_get_user_data] and [method space_get_body_move_events]; it does not replace the native backend's internal body pointer. The Variant is retained until replaced or the body is freed.

method.name: space_get_body_move_events
method.description: Returns a flat [Array] of alternating application user-data and [Transform2D] entries for bodies moved in the most recent native step: [code][data0, transform0, data1, transform1, ...][/code]. Assign metadata with [method body_set_user_data] to identify bodies. Read after stepping, outside locked physics callbacks. An invalid or locked space reports an error and returns an empty array.

method.name: space_portable_capture
method.description: Captures a portable checkpoint of [param space] immediately. Returns [code]{"error": Error, "bytes": PackedByteArray, "refusal": int}[/code], where [code]refusal[/code] is a nonzero diagnostic code when the capture is refused. Succeeds only at the physics phase boundary (outside stepping and query flushing, after the space's step effects were consumed); otherwise [code]error[/code] is [constant ERR_BUSY]. Cached hit or joint events, named bodies and pointers outside the symbolic registry return [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE].

method.name: space_portable_capture_info
method.description: Returns statistics of the most recent portable capture of [param space]: [code]captures[/code], [code]births[/code], [code]retirements[/code], [code]survivors[/code], [code]records[/code] and [code]bindings[/code]. Empty if the space was never captured.

method.name: space_portable_digest
method.description: Returns the 32-byte complete-state digest of [param space]'s native world, with every pointer named symbolically, or an empty array if the space is locked or holds unsupported pointers. A restored space and its source have equal digests while they step identically.

method.name: space_portable_request_capture
method.description: Requests a portable capture of [param space] at the next physics phase boundary, immediately after the space's state sync and before scripts run. Collect it with [method space_portable_take_capture]. Returns an [enum Error] code.

method.name: space_portable_restore
method.description: Restores a portable checkpoint into a fresh space with new body RIDs. Returns [code]{"error": Error, "space": RID, "default_area": RID, "bodies": {source body id: RID}}[/code]; the new space is inactive. [param object_map] maps every non-zero source instance id (node and canvas instance ids, object user data) to an [Object] or instance id; an unmapped id fails with [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST]. [param shape_map] maps source shape RID ids to shape [RID]s; when empty, the source shape RIDs of this server are used. Corrupt or tampered bytes fail with [constant ERR_FILE_CORRUPT], another format version or position width with [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED]. Bodies, extra areas (with overrides, step order and overlap state), every joint type, collision exceptions and reported contacts are restored; [code]areas[/code] and [code]joints[/code] map source ids to new RIDs as well. Callbacks are rebound through [param callable_map], keyed [code]"state_sync:<source id>"[/code], [code]"force_integration:<source id>"[/code], [code]"body_monitor:<source id>"[/code] or [code]"area_monitor:<source id>"[/code]; a method callable whose object is in [param object_map] is rebound automatically. An unresolvable force-integration or monitor callback fails with [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST]; an unresolvable state-sync callback is dropped.

method.name: space_portable_take_capture
method.description: Returns the capture taken at the phase boundary after [method space_portable_request_capture], as [code]{"error": Error, "bytes": PackedByteArray}[/code]. [code]error[/code] is [constant ERR_BUSY] while the capture is still pending and [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if none was requested.
